gameModle1.textString:
The night came

I can only along the steps

looking for you in the light

The world is still

even boarded the tower

also can not touch you

Star countless

also can walk over

I don't care ridicule of world

In despair

I betray everything

want to reverse the world

Get caught in my own trap

lose everthing

can't go back

Helpless butterfly

return to the starting point

choose the road again

Recasting the world

the road without you

I wish to end

New hope

perhaps difficult

there is a slim chance

set off again

go through the universe

connecting all cultures

unite in a concerted effort

casting sword cut doomsday

and then remember the past

fate has ended

the soul rest in peace

be story  hundred years
